scheme_name: Maintenance Grant to Institutions and Organizations Engaged in Cultural Activities
other_conditions: The organization must have been engaged in cultural activities for at least two years.
Accounts must be duly audited and approved by a competent person or body as per the Memorandum of Association.
The organization must not be run for profit to any individual or body of individuals.
Utilization certificates for all previously received grants must have been submitted before applying for a new grant.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹3,000 for maintenance and ₹5,000 for cultural activities.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attest, if required)
